verdicts.missing: The quote describes the previous behavior (before 15) but not the GRANT/REVOKE mechanism as an example. The core of the claim is supported, but the 'e.g. via GRANT/REVOKE' specific is not stated.

The quote only says that previously a login role could add/remove members even without ADMIN OPTION. It does not state that an explicit grant of ADMIN OPTION on the role's own membership preserves the behavior after the change.
